name: Enshrouded
description: Enshrouded dedicated server. The game only has a Windows server, so it runs under Proton; the first start sets Proton up and takes a few minutes longer. The server uses a single UDP port, 15637 by convention. The name, port, player slots and difficulty below are written to enshrouded_server.json before every start. The passwords are written to that file's userGroups when the server is installed; edit them there afterwards.
startup_command: proton run ./enshrouded_server.exe & ENS_PID=$!; trap 'echo "[Atlas] Stop requested; waiting for Enshrouded to save and exit..."' INT TERM; tail -c0 -F ./logs/enshrouded_server.log --pid="${ENS_PID}" 2>/dev/null & while kill -0 "${ENS_PID}" 2>/dev/null; do wait "${ENS_PID}"; done

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players enter to join. Used when the server is installed; a random one is generated when empty. To change it later, edit userGroups in enshrouded_server.json.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password that lets a player join as an admin. Used when the server is installed; a random one is generated when empty. It must differ from the server password. To change it later, edit userGroups in enshrouded_server.json.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: Game settings preset. Custom uses the gameSettings section of enshrouded_server.json.

variables.name: Windows Build
variables.description: Makes SteamCMD download the Windows build, which is the only one this game has.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. The installer and the update check on start both use it.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Check Steam for a game update every time the server starts.
